subject: Annotated SDLC evidence and narrow-scope CI/Secrets review — LumenBank SIG follow-up
messages:
From: LumenBank Security Assessment <sig-assessor@thirdparty-assessors.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Narrow-scope: SDLC artifacts for SIG - request

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intake on the SIG submission. We've completed an initial review and need a narrow-scope follow-up focused on: code review evidence, PR gating enforcement (policy exceptions, if any), CI job run logs for PR 700-740 window, and a short summary of how secrets are provisioned to runners (ephemeral vs long-lived).

To keep this small, please provide: 1) one annotated code-review sample that shows reviewer approvals + comment thread and remediation, 2) the CI job log for the run that gated PR-732, 3) the secrets stewardship matrix that lists which pipeline steps get which credential type, and 4) a short note describing emergency/rollback authorization for deploys.

Goal: we want enough trace to validate control effectiveness without needing the full evidence bundle. Can you send the artifacts by EOD PT on Monday (2027-07-12)?

If any of these items are sensitive for the inbox, point me to a secure transfer link and we'll download from there.

Regards,
Maya Patel
Lead Assessor — ThirdParty Assessors
sig-assessor@thirdparty-assessors.com

---
(please include PR urls or commit SHAs where applicable)

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: devops@lumenbank.com
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Narrow-scope: SDLC artifacts for SIG - request

Team —

Assessor (Maya) has asked for a narrow-scope evidence set for LumenBank's SIG follow-up. Action items I've carved up: 

- Jordan: pull the PR-732 run log and the annotated code-review sample (pick the best redaction-friendly thread). Please redact personal emails and leave reviewer handles. Attach diff/patch and log.
- Marissa: export the current secrets stewardship matrix (which vault roles map to pipeline steps) and write a 2–3 sentence summary of ephemeral token lifecycle (rotation, TTLs, KMS integration).
- I'll draft a brief note on rollback/approval exceptions and where we store the change authorization records (DocuSign + deploy audit ID).

Timeline: aim to have a collated bundle by Mon EOD PT (2027-07-12). If you need to gate on approvals to share logs, mark the attachments and I'll route through secure transfer (S3 presigned link).

When you reply, please reference the specific file names so I can keep the attachment index aligned with their ask.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachment hints: code-review-sample-PR-732.diff (strip unrelated commits), ci-job-logs-20270710.txt (mask runner IPs), secrets-stewardship-matrix.xlsx (sensitive columns redacted)

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 14:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Narrow-scope: SDLC artifacts for SIG - request

Irene — quick update. I pulled PR-732 artifacts: commit SHAs, reviewer approvals, and the CI gate that failed before the fix. Files attached: code-review-sample-PR-732.diff and ci-job-logs-20270710.txt. Notes: 

- The PR shows 2 reviewers, 1 request-for-changes comment, and the subsequent fix commit (SHA: 4f3c9a). I've removed unrelated comment threads and replaced personal emails with reviewer initials (e.g., rn/mb).
- CI log redacted: runner metadata and node IPs replaced with <REDACTED>. The failing step was `unit-tests` due to a dependency pinning error; gating policy behaved as expected (block on failing job).

If this looks good, I'll upload these to a presigned S3 link and add to the bundle.

-Jordan

---
Attachment: code-review-sample-PR-732.diff (1.2MB), ci-job-logs-20270710.txt (320KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, sig-assessor@thirdparty-assessors.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 16:37:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Narrow-scope: SDLC artifacts for SIG - request — bundle uploaded

Hi all —

I've assembled the requested artifacts and uploaded them to a secure bucket. Summary of items and where to find them: 

1) code-review-sample-PR-732.diff — includes reviewer comments and the fix commit (SHA 4f3c9a). Stored: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-lumenbank-sdlc-annotated (link has viewer-only permissions).
2) ci-job-logs-20270710.txt — redacted for PII and runner metadata; shows failed `unit-tests` step, re-run timestamp, and verification on re-run.
3) secrets-stewardship-matrix.xlsx — maps pipeline stages to credential types (KMS-wrapped keys for deploy, ephemeral token for test runner). Column "AccessOwner" reduced to team aliases, column "KeyArn" masked.
4) Short note: rollback/approval practice — emergency rollback requires on-call Eng lead + Security approval recorded via DocuSign envelope ID DOC-20270710-89; deploy audit IDs are retained in our deploy-trace DB with 180-day retention.

I've also opened a small Jira (JIRA-SEC-459) with links to each artifact and the minimal explanation. If Maya needs raw logs (not redacted) for evidence, we'll prepare an encrypted transfer and require a signed NDA amendment.

Maya — please confirm receipt when convenient.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Ops Program Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: secrets-stewardship-matrix.xlsx
